name: Stack-TS-TW
blurb: Swipeable card stack that rotates and scales as cards are dragged away.
description: Interactive 3D card stack with drag-to-swipe interaction. Cards rotate and scale based on position; dragging beyond sensitivity threshold sends the card to the back. Supports autoplay, optional random rotation, and mobile click-only mode.
use_when: Card galleries, image stacks, or any UI where swiping through items feels natural and playful.
avoid_when: Static content or devices with only mouse (no touch). Requires a sized parent container.
a11y: Drag and click handlers for interaction; keyboard navigation not implemented. Mobile click-only mode improves touch accessibility.
